name: Received Margin Or Collateral 6
definition: Information on the received margin or collateral of the transaction.

InitialMarginReceivedPreHaircut.name: Initial Margin Received Pre Haircut
InitialMarginReceivedPreHaircut.definition: Value of the initial margin received by the reporting counterparty from the other counterparty.|Where initial margin is received on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of initial margin received for the portfolio.

InitialMarginReceivedPostHaircut.name: Initial Margin Received Post Haircut
InitialMarginReceivedPostHaircut.definition: Value of the initial margin received by the reporting counterparty from the other counterparty.|Where initial margin is received on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of initial margin received for the portfolio.|Post-haircut values of margins depend on associated risk of changes in collateral value and therefore on the nature of the collateral posted (or collected).

VariationMarginReceivedPreHaircut.name: Variation Margin Received Pre Haircut
VariationMarginReceivedPreHaircut.definition: Value of the variation margin received, including cash settled, by the reporting counterparty from the other counterparty. |Where variation margin is received on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of variation margin received for the portfolio.

VariationMarginReceivedPostHaircut.name: Variation Margin Received Post Haircut
VariationMarginReceivedPostHaircut.definition: Value of the variation margin received, including cash settled, by the reporting counterparty from the other counterparty. |Where variation margin is received on a portfolio basis, this field should include the overall value of variation margin received for the portfolio.|Post-haircut values of margins depend on associated risk of changes in collateral value and therefore on the nature of the collateral posted (or collected).

ExcessCollateralReceived.name: Excess Collateral Received
ExcessCollateralReceived.definition: Value of collateral received in excess of the required collateral.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
